lines.text: All of tomorrow in a few words. Some people need four voice memos to cancel lunch.
Horoscopes predict tomorrow too. Not one has ever mentioned pants.
You turned me up to 11 on purpose. Most daring thing you've done all year.
When you read this, your mouth hangs open a little. Nobody else was going to tell you.
The little figure always looks so calm. It has no idea it's supposed to be you.
